title: Microsoft 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting — the first governance venue after the two-segment recast
source: SEC: Microsoft's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30 (accession 0001193125-26-323660, filed 2026-07-29, primary document msft-20260630.htm) — RE-FETCHED DIRECT FROM sec.gov AND TEXT-EXTRACTED INDEPENDENTLY BY THIS LANE 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 360,299 bytes, 356,946 chars of extracted text), not taken on the proposing lane's word. It states the date TWICE: on the cover page under DOCUMENTS INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE — 'Portions of the definitive Proxy Statement to be delivered to shareholders in connection with the Annual Meeting of Shareholders to be held on December 8, 2026 are incorporated by reference into Part III' — and again in Part III Item 10, 'our Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Shareholders to be held December 8, 2026'. December 8, 2026 is the ONLY December-2026 meeting date string anywhere in the document. PROMOTED FROM estimate TO confirmed BY THIS LANE'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH, on two counts, both measured rather than asserted: (1) SEC: is a member of scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs's CONFIRMED_PREFIX list, and a signed annual report is the company's own primary statement of its own meeting date — the proposal that seeded this entry filed EST: only because a proposal is always status estimate (docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md, issue #1717), a constraint that binds the proposal file and not the canonical file the owning lane writes; (2) the 10-K-stated date was tested out-of-sample against the date the eventual DEF 14A actually carried, for the eight most recent years, both sides fetched direct from sec.gov 2026-09-09 — 2018 11-28, 2019 12-04, 2020 12-02, 2021 11-30, 2022 12-13, 2023 12-07, 2024 12-10, 2025 12-05 — EIGHT MATCHES OUT OF EIGHT, no misses. FALSIFIER: Microsoft's definitive DEF 14A (historically filed Oct 14-27; see the proposed msft-def14a-2026-10-21 entry) naming any date other than 2026-12-08 breaks the 8/8 and re-keys this entry. Confirmation licenses NOTHING here — docs/research/events/msft-annual-meeting-2026-12-08.md measures the meeting day to be a non-event at every horizon. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the msft-2026-10-27-print adjacency sweep
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, which read the single prior proposal (proposals/msft-annual-meeting-2026-12-08.from-msft-2026-10-27-print.json, now inert and left in place per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md) and then re-verified its load-bearing fact from the primary filing rather than inheriting it. WHY IT EARNS A ROW: it is the first annual meeting held under the two-segment reporting structure the 2026-09-02 8-K announced (Agents and Infra / Devices and Consumer), so the shareholder-proposal slate and the board's own framing of AI capex land after investors have seen exactly one quarter of standalone dollar Azure disclosure. WHY IMPACT IS LOW, AND NOW MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: an n=16 event study of every MSFT annual meeting 2010-2025 — each date read from that year's own DEF 14A on sec.gov — puts MSFT minus QQQ on meeting day at mean -0.07%, median -0.15%, win 6/16 (P=0.25 against the 49% base rate), and the ENTIRE sixteen-year range is [-0.96pp, +0.76pp], a band 78.4% of ordinary 2010+ sessions also sit inside. The meeting convenes 08:30 Pacific / 11:30 ET, which intraday-edges.mjs MSFT (723 sessions) puts in the third-quietest hourly bar of the session (0.273% mean absolute move, 10.8% of daily volatility, vs the 09:30 bar's 0.633% and 30.4%). No house playbook in docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md or docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md is governance-keyed, and none fires here. KIND IS AN HONEST APPROXIMATION: scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs's KINDS list has no company-governance slot, and 'sector' is the list's catch-all for a scheduled structural event that is neither an earnings print nor a product launch; 'product-launch' would be a worse fit than the imprecision. ATTRIBUTION TRAP, stated up front: 2026-12-08 is a Tuesday sitting one day before fomc-2026-12-09 and two before cpi-2026-12-10, with government-funding-deadline-2026-12-11 closing the week — twenty-four tracked events fall within five days of it. Any MSFT move that session has a macro explanation long before it has a governance one, which is exactly why every measurement in the ledger is benchmark-relative.
